# Tracebench

> Agent Ops Workbench — HITL control room for AI agents (Dominik Pawlikowski).

Demo Mode (default): AGENT_TRANSPORT=fixture, JEV_ADAPTER=mock, EVAL_SCORER=mock-jev — ZERO API keys.

## Surfaces

- / — Landing
- /runs — Seeded runs (incl. run_live_approve, run_pipeline_ops)
- /runs/[id] — Timeline, HITL, audit, logs (A2A filter)
- /runs/[id]/graph — Read-only xyflow observe graph
- /evals — mock-jev release gate
- /dashboards — Ops boards (localStorage layout)
- /policy — Jev risk matrix
- /help — Hub + demo-mode + failure-gallery
- /architecture — Diagram + invariants
- /api/health — Readiness; demoMode.kind=demo|hybrid|live; 503 on critical fail

## Docs

- docs/DEMO_SCRIPT.md — 90s click path
- docs/PRODUCT_PLAN.md — roadmap
- docs/testing.md — pyramid
- docs/adr/ — events, Jev, multi-agent
